embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
fields.value: Meta; three co-authors are from Chandar Research Lab/Mila/Polytechnique Montréal — RoboJEPA is a Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world model trained on 23 public manipulation datasets spanning 12 robot platforms, scaled from 22M to 8B parameters.

fields.name: Position Forcing: Self-Conditioning 3D Generation
fields.value: Tencent Hunyuan; corresponding author Chunchao Guo lists a tencent.com address — The paper targets single-stage 3D generative models that represent shapes as unordered sets of latent tokens (VecSet representations), which must implicitly infer each token's position during denoising.

fields.name: OmniCam: Omni-Camera Trajectory Generation via Geometry-Grounded Pose Token Learning
fields.value: Tencent Hunyuan; Tencent affiliation is inferred from co-author Chunchao Guo, who is independently confirmed as Tencent Hunyuan (tencent.com email, corresponding author) on the companion submission 2610.10342 the same week — OmniCam is an autoregressive model that generates camera pose trajectories from a single panorama plus a text description of the desired camera motion, using a panoramic point-cloud encoder and a hybrid rotation/translation pose tokenization.

fields.name: Hardware-aware Calibrated Clustered Attention for Efficient Visual Geometric Transformers
fields.value: Robert Bosch GmbH; three of four authors list Bosch, the fourth lists Ruhr University Bochum only); comparable in kind to other hardware-adjacent companies on the "keep and flag" list — The paper speeds up the global attention layers of the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT), a 3D scene-reconstruction model, with a hardware-friendly "blockwise clustered attention" (BC attention) that restricts clustering to hardware-aligned neighborhood blocks.

fields.name: World Models' Last Exam in Physics
fields.value: Peking University and Tsinghua University are academic, and "Navers Lab" / "Einsia.AI" could not be independently verified as established industry labs (web search was unavailable for this check). Kept per SKILL.md's "genuinely unsure → flag rather than drop" rule. (flag) — Video world models can produce visually convincing but physically inconsistent sequences, which is a concern for their use in prediction and planning for embodied AI.

fields.name: Efficient Gaussian Splatting Sequence Compression with Standard Video Codecs
fields.value: Qualcomm — The paper presents GSCV, a Gaussian Splatting (GS) sequence compression method built on standard video codecs.

fields.name: Real-time Rendering of Pre-integrated Neural Emitters
fields.value: Huawei Technologies — The paper introduces Neural Emission Fields (NEF), a neural field that precomputes direct illumination in the volume around a light emitter, conditioned on position, normal, view direction and material, so that rendering requires only a single network evaluation per shading point instead of runtime

fields.name: MC-Sparse: Deconstructing and Closing the Dense-Sparse Attention Gap in Diffusion Transformers
fields.value: Tencent — The paper proposes MC-Sparse (Meta-Cached Sparse Attention), a training-free sparse-attention framework for diffusion transformers that combines tile-aligned query grouping, token-level key-value selection, and temporal reuse of selections and residuals across denoising steps.

fields.name: InterMimicGen: Scaling Humanoid Loco-Manipulation through Self-Evolving Motion Imitation
fields.value: NVIDIA — The paper presents InterMimicGen, a framework that retargets motion-captured human-object interaction data to humanoid robots with dexterous hands, trains a physics-based tracking policy in simulation, and uses an iterative "self-evolving" augmentation loop to expand the motion dataset while keeping

fields.name: GeoWM: Efficient Direct World Modeling in Explicit Geometry
fields.value: Huawei Noah's Ark Lab, Canada (flag) — Modeling 3D scene geometry and its evolution over time is central to autonomous driving and robotics, but the common world-model paradigm of predicting future images or latent representations and then recovering geometry does not explicitly model geometric structure and relies on recursive rollouts

fields.name: SteadySplats: Resampling of Low-Variance Gaussians for High-Fidelity Stochastic Rendering
fields.value: NVIDIA; Google DeepMind — The paper proposes SteadySplats, a method for high-fidelity stochastic order-independent-transparency rendering of 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, combining a training-time color-variance regularizer with inference-time history-based spatial resampling and temporal resampling for camera-motion coheren

fields.name: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
fields.value: Sber; individual per-author institution tags were not resolvable from the retrieved text beyond the group-level attribution — Kandinsky 6.0 Video introduces two diffusion foundation models — Lite (3B parameters) and Pro (29B parameters) — for synchronized video and audio generation, producing 5-second clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio including lip-sync across multiple generation modes.

fields.name: FLEX-WAM: Flexible Block-Causal World-Action Models for Long-Horizon Imagination and Planning
fields.value: NVIDIA — FLEX-WAM is a flexible block-causal world-action model that predicts action-conditioned futures, generates feasible actions, and supports planning in imagination, while handling variable-length context and stable long multi-step autoregressive rollouts.
